# Patched go-imap v1.2.1 (SR3-mail-k18)

Upstream github.com/emersion/go-imap v1.2.1 (go.sum h1:+s9ZjMEjOB8NzZMVTM3cCenz2JrQIGGo5j1df19WjTA=), the packages broker imports, without tests; LICENSE is upstream's. broker/go.mod replaces the module with this directory. Two edits, in client/client.go only, each marked `agentos:`: `reader` recovers a panic, closes the connection and ends (the in-flight command then fails with errClosed); `handle` unlocks `handlersLocker` by `defer`, so a recovered handler panic does not leave it held and the session's deferred Logout cannot deadlock. date.go differs only by gofmt's comment reflow (CI's Format step). No response handler is edited. See broker/mail/ASSUMPTIONS.md for when to drop this.
